m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: So now you two are conspiring with the Ice Keepers? Give me one good reason I shouldn't tell Chairman Meow you've betrayed him?
I'll give you two! First, because you have to cool down - all this anger is not healthy, Shamiss! Second, because we're going to fix things.
My Master and I are journeying to the Tower of Babble, where we will retrieve an artifact to help everyone around here stop being so silly!
The Tower of Babble? Are you sure? Talk about being bad for your health... it's very dangerous, but I have nothing to lose...
All right, I'll make a deal. I'll support this mad endeavor on one condition - you bring back the Yakhal Chronoshard. They say it's there.
It's a deal. But when we come back, not only do you have to support us, but you have to be nice too.
Hmm. Maybe. But no promises on that front, lassie.
Kind of a weird place to build a tower, isn't it, Master? Oh, and there's a guard. Let's go talk to him.
None shall pass! According to Babble Tower regulation 1304, suspicious persons are banned from entering the Tower during restricted hours.
We need to talk, not fight! Miriam, you know I love you, but I honestly think you're being just as hard-headed as the Chairman in this respect.
You mean your father? Is that why you ask me to stop fighting? Tell me this - if he won't listen to you, why should I?
That's not fair. You know I don't take my father's side in this! My loyalties are divided. That's why I need the Wizard's help.
Wizard, there's a desert legend about a place known as the Tower of Babble. Inside is an artifact that can overcome all communication barriers.
For the good of both the Bumbai and the Sayameez, I ask you to visit the Tower of Babble and find this artifact. Please, you must.
It's going to take a miracle to get the Rebels and my father to find a compromise. Please visit the Tower of Babble. It's our only hope.
